subject: general
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the sister of B'.

If P % R & Y @ Z # M % N, then how is M related to P?
solution:
Family chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bd089b50ccc65418062a914a10405a9c41cac7d59b1a2ba35d018959360e54.png] 

Drawing the family tree,

Family Tree :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06233dc5877271480355ee417d94d6a24b5d3e68970e44352da3424431d8afcb.png] 

M is sister of Z and P is daughter of Z, so, M is paternal aunt of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Paternal aunt".**
